verses.original: וַיּוֹלִכֵ֖נִי אֶל־ הַשָּׁ֑עַר שַׁ֕עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פֹּנֶ֖ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·li·ḵê·nî ’el- haš·šā·‘ar ša·‘ar ’ă·šer pō·neh de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: Then the man brought me back to the gate - that faces . . . east

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה כְּבוֹד֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ֖א מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וְקוֹל֗וֹ כְּקוֹל֙ רַבִּ֔ים מַ֣יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֵאִ֥ירָה מִכְּבֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh kə·ḇō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl bā mid·de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏîm wə·qō·w·lōw kə·qō·wl rab·bîm ma·yim wə·hā·’ā·reṣ hê·’î·rāh mik·kə·ḇō·ḏōw
verses.literal: and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east His voice was like the roar of many waters and the earth shone with His glory

verses.original: וּכְמַרְאֵ֨ה רָאִ֗יתִי הַמַּרְאֶ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר כַּמַּרְאֶ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ רָאִ֙יתִי֙ בְּבֹאִי֙ לְשַׁחֵ֣ת אֶת־ הָעִ֔יר וּמַרְא֕וֹת כַּמַּרְאֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי אֶל־ נְהַר־ כְּבָ֑ר וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל־ פָּנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·mar·’êh rā·’î·ṯî ham·mar·’eh ’ă·šer kam·mar·’eh ’ă·šer- rā·’î·ṯî bə·ḇō·’î lə·ša·ḥêṯ ’eṯ- hā·‘îr ū·mar·’ō·wṯ kam·mar·’eh ’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯî ’el- nə·har- kə·ḇār wā·’ep·pōl ’el- pā·nāy
verses.literal: The vision I saw was like the vision - - - I had seen when He came to destroy - the city and like the visions - I had seen by the River Kebar I fell facedown . . .

verses.original: וּכְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה בָּ֣א אֶל־ הַבָּ֑יִת דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh bā ’el- hab·bā·yiṯ de·reḵ ša·‘ar ’ă·šer pā·nāw de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: and the glory of the LORD entered . . . the temple through the gate - facing . . . east

verses.original: ר֔וּחַ וַתִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי וַתְּבִיאֵ֕נִי אֶל־ הַפְּנִימִ֑י וְהִנֵּ֛ה הֶֽחָצֵ֖ר כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה מָלֵ֥א הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ wat·tiś·śā·’ê·nî wat·tə·ḇî·’ê·nî ’el- hap·pə·nî·mî wə·hin·nêh he·ḥā·ṣêr ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh mā·lê hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner . . . court and the glory of the LORD filled the temple

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ הָיָ֥ה עֹמֵ֖ד אֶצְלִֽי׃ וָאֶשְׁמַ֛ע מִדַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י מֵהַבָּ֑יִת
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš hā·yāh ‘ō·mêḏ ’eṣ·lî wā·’eš·ma‘ mid·dab·bêr ’ê·lay mê·hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: While the man was standing beside me I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ אֶת־ מְק֣וֹם כִּסְאִ֗י וְאֶת־ מְקוֹם֙ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֶשְׁכָּן־ שָׁ֛ם בְּת֥וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעוֹלָ֑ם בֵּֽית־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל וְלֹ֣א ע֣וֹד יְטַמְּא֣וּ קָדְשִׁ֞י שֵׁ֣ם הֵ֤מָּה וּמַלְכֵיהֶם֙ בִּזְנוּתָ֔ם וּבְפִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם בָּמוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām ’eṯ- mə·qō·wm kis·’î wə·’eṯ- mə·qō·wm kap·pō·wṯ raḡ·lay ’ă·šer ’eš·kān- šām bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·‘ō·w·lām bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō ‘ō·wḏ yə·ṭam·mə·’ū qāḏ·šî šêm hêm·māh ū·mal·ḵê·hem biz·nū·ṯām ū·ḇə·p̄iḡ·rê mal·ḵê·hem bā·mō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: and He said to me Son of man - this is the place of My throne - and the place for the soles of My feet where I will dwell . . . among the Israelites forever . . . The house of Israel will never again defile My holy name neither they nor their kings by their prostitution and by the funeral offerings for their kings at their deaths

verses.original: בְּתִתָּ֨ם סִפָּ֜ם אֶת־ סִפִּ֗י וּמְזֽוּזָתָם֙ אֵ֣צֶל מְזוּזָתִ֔י וְהַקִּ֖יר בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְטִמְּא֣וּ׀ אֶת־ קָדְשִׁ֗י שֵׁ֣ם בְּתֽוֹעֲבוֹתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֔וּ וָאֲכַ֥ל אֹתָ֖ם בְּאַפִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṯit·tām sip·pām ’eṯ- sip·pî ū·mə·zū·zā·ṯām ’ê·ṣel mə·zū·zā·ṯî wə·haq·qîr bê·nî ū·ḇê·nê·hem wə·ṭim·mə·’ū ’eṯ- qāḏ·šî šêm bə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū wā·’ă·ḵal ’ō·ṯām bə·’ap·pî
verses.literal: When they placed their threshold next to My threshold and their doorposts beside My doorposts with only a wall between Me and them . . . they defiled - My holy name by the abominations - they committed Therefore I have consumed them in My anger

verses.original: עַתָּ֞ה יְרַחֲק֧וּ אֶת־ מִמֶּ֑נִּי זְנוּתָ֛ם וּפִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֥י בְתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh yə·ra·ḥă·qū ’eṯ- mim·men·nî zə·nū·ṯām ū·p̄iḡ·rê mal·ḵê·hem wə·šā·ḵan·tî ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵām lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Now let them remove - far from Me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings and I will dwell among them forever

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם הַגֵּ֤ד אֶת־ בֵּֽית־ הַבַּ֔יִת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ וְיִכָּלְמ֖וּ מֵעֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וּמָדְד֖וּ אֶת־ תָּכְנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hag·gêḏ ’eṯ- bêṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- wə·yik·kā·lə·mū mê·‘ă·wō·nō·w·ṯê·hem ū·mā·ḏə·ḏū ’eṯ- tā·ḵə·nîṯ
verses.literal: As for you son of man describe - the temple to the [people] of Israel - so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities Let them measure - the plan

verses.original: וְאִֽם־ נִכְלְמ֞וּ מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֗וּ הוֹדַ֣ע אוֹתָ֔ם צוּרַ֣ת הַבַּ֡יִת וּתְכוּנָת֡וֹ וּמוֹצָאָ֡יו וּמוֹבָאָ֣יו וְֽכָל־ צֽוּרֹתָ֡ו וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ חֻקֹּתָיו֩ וְכָל־ צוּרֹתָי וְכָל־ תּוֹרֹתוֹ וּכְתֹ֖ב לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְיִשְׁמְר֞וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ צוּרָת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֻקֹּתָ֖יו וְעָשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- niḵ·lə·mū mik·kōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śū hō·w·ḏa‘ ’ō·w·ṯām ṣū·raṯ hab·ba·yiṯ ū·ṯə·ḵū·nā·ṯōw ū·mō·w·ṣā·’āw ū·mō·w·ḇā·’āw wə·ḵāl ṣū·rō·ṯå̄w wə·’êṯ kāl- ḥuq·qō·ṯāw wə·ḵāl ṣū·rō·ṯå̄y wə·ḵāl tō·rō·ṯō ū·ḵə·ṯōḇ lə·‘ê·nê·hem wə·yiš·mə·rū ’eṯ- kāl- ṣū·rā·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- kāl- ḥuq·qō·ṯāw wə·‘ā·śū ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: and if they are ashamed of all - they have done [then] make known to them the design of the temple its arrangement and its exits and entrances its whole design - along with all its statutes forms and laws Write it down in their sight so that they may keep - its complete design and all its statutes and may carry them out -

verses.original: זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת כָּל־ סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ גְּבֻל֞וֹ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָ֠הָר קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָדָשִׁ֔ים הִנֵּה־ זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hab·bā·yiṯ kāl- sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ gə·ḇu·lōw ‘al- rōš hā·hār qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm hin·nêh- zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: This is the law of the temple All its surrounding . . . territory on top of the mountain will be most holy . . . Yes this is the law of the temple

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה מִדּ֤וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ בָּֽאַמּ֔וֹת אַמָּ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה וָטֹ֑פַח וְחֵ֨יק הָאַמָּ֜ה וְאַמָּה־ רֹ֗חַב וּגְבוּלָ֨הּ אֶל־ הָאֶחָ֔ד זֶ֣רֶת סָבִיב֙ שְׂפָתָ֤הּ וְזֶ֖ה גַּ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh mid·dō·wṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ bā·’am·mō·wṯ ’am·māh ’am·māh wā·ṭō·p̄aḥ wə·ḥêq hā·’am·māh wə·’am·māh- rō·ḥaḇ ū·ḡə·ḇū·lāh ’el- hā·’e·ḥāḏ ze·reṯ sā·ḇîḇ śə·p̄ā·ṯāh wə·zeh gaḇ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits a cubit . . . and a handbreadth Its gutter [shall be] a cubit deep and a cubit wide with a rim . . . of one span around its edge And this [is] the height of the altar

verses.original: וּמֵחֵ֨יק הָאָ֜רֶץ עַד־ הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה֙ הָעֲזָרָ֤ה שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֔וֹת אֶחָ֑ת אַמָּ֣ה וְרֹ֖חַב הַקְּטַנָּ֜ה וּמֵהֳעֲזָרָ֨ה עַד־ הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ הָעֲזָרָ֤ה אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֔וֹת הָאַמָּֽה׃ וְרֹ֖חַב
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·ḥêq hā·’ā·reṣ ‘aḏ- hat·taḥ·tō·w·nāh hā·‘ă·zā·rāh šə·ta·yim ’am·mō·wṯ ’e·ḥāṯ ’am·māh wə·rō·ḥaḇ haq·qə·ṭan·nāh ū·mê·ho·‘ă·zā·rāh ‘aḏ- hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh hā·‘ă·zā·rāh ’ar·ba‘ ’am·mō·wṯ hā·’am·māh wə·rō·ḥaḇ
verses.literal: The space from the gutter on the ground to the lower ledge [shall be] two cubits and [the ledge] one cubit wide [The space] from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge [shall be] four cubits and [the ledge] one cubit wide

verses.original: וְהַֽהַרְאֵ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֑וֹת אַרְבַּֽע׃ הַקְּרָנ֖וֹת וּלְמַ֔עְלָה וּמֵהָאֲרִאֵ֣יל
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·har·’êl ’ar·ba‘ ’am·mō·wṯ ’ar·ba‘ haq·qə·rā·nō·wṯ ū·lə·ma‘·lāh ū·mē·hå̄·ʾă·ri·ʾēl
verses.literal: The altar hearth [shall be] four cubits [high] and four horns shall project upward from the hearth

verses.original: וְהָאֲרִאֵיל רָב֕וּעַ אֶ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥עַת רְבָעָֽיו׃ שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ בִּשְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה רֹ֑חַב
verses.transliteration: wə·hå̄·ʾă·ri·ʾēl rā·ḇū·a‘ ’el ’ar·ba·‘aṯ rə·ḇā·‘āw šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ’ō·reḵ biš·têm ‘eś·rêh rō·ḥaḇ
verses.literal: The altar hearth [shall be] square at its four corners twelve [cubits] . . . long [and] twelve [cubits] . . . wide

verses.original: וְהָעֲזָרָ֞ה אֶ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣עַת רְבָעֶ֑יהָ אַרְבַּ֧ע עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֹ֗רֶךְ בְּאַרְבַּ֤ע עֶשְׂרֵה֙ רֹ֔חַב וְהַגְּבוּל חֲצִ֣י הָאַמָּ֗ה וְהַֽחֵיק־ אַמָּה֙ סָבִ֨יב אוֹתָ֜הּ לָ֤הּ סָבִ֔יב וּמַעֲלֹתֵ֖הוּ פְּנ֥וֹת קָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ă·zā·rāh ’el ’ar·ba·‘aṯ rə·ḇā·‘e·hā ’ar·ba‘ ‘eś·rêh ’ō·reḵ bə·’ar·ba‘ ‘eś·rêh rō·ḥaḇ wə·hag·gə·ḇūl ḥă·ṣî hā·’am·māh wə·ha·ḥêq- ’am·māh sā·ḇîḇ ’ō·w·ṯāh lāh sā·ḇîḇ ū·ma·‘ă·lō·ṯê·hū pə·nō·wṯ qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: The ledge [shall also be] square . . . . . . fourteen [cubits] . . . long and fourteen [cubits] . . . wide with a rim of half a cubit and a gutter of a cubit all around it - The steps of the altar [shall] face east

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ אֵ֚לֶּה חֻקּ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּי֖וֹם הֵעָֽשׂוֹת֑וֹ עוֹלָ֔ה לְהַעֲל֤וֹת עָלָיו֙ דָּֽם׃ וְלִזְרֹ֥ק עָלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’êl·leh ḥuq·qō·wṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ bə·yō·wm hê·‘ā·śō·w·ṯōw ‘ō·w·lāh lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ‘ā·lāw dām wə·liz·rōq ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Then He said to me Son of man this is what the Lord GOD says These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is constructed so that burnt offerings may be sacrificed on it and blood may be splattered on it

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה בֶּן־ פַּ֥ר בָּקָ֖ר לְחַטָּֽאת׃ אֶל־ הַלְוִיִּ֡ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵם֩ מִזֶּ֨רַע צָד֜וֹק הַקְּרֹבִ֣ים אֵלַ֗י לְשָֽׁרְתֵ֑נִי נְאֻ֛ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ben- par bā·qār lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’el- hal·wî·yim hak·kō·hă·nîm ’ă·šer hêm miz·ze·ra‘ ṣā·ḏō·wq haq·qə·rō·ḇîm ’ê·lay lə·šā·rə·ṯê·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: You are to give a young bull from the herd as a sin offering to the Levitical priests who are of the family of Zadok who approach Me to minister before Me declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִדָּמ֗וֹ וְנָ֨תַתָּ֜ה עַל־ אַרְבַּ֤ע קַרְנֹתָיו֙ וְאֶל־ אַרְבַּע֙ פִּנּ֣וֹת הָעֲזָרָ֔ה וְאֶֽל־ סָבִ֑יב הַגְּב֖וּל וְחִטֵּאתָ֥ אוֹת֖וֹ וְכִפַּרְתָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā mid·dā·mōw wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ qar·nō·ṯāw wə·’el- ’ar·ba‘ pin·nō·wṯ hā·‘ă·zā·rāh wə·’el- sā·ḇîḇ hag·gə·ḇūl wə·ḥiṭ·ṭê·ṯā ’ō·w·ṯōw wə·ḵip·par·tā·hū
verses.literal: You are to take some of its blood and put [it] on the four horns of the [altar] on the four corners of the ledge . . . and all around the rim thus you will cleanse - the altar and make atonement for it

verses.original: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הַפָּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֑את וּשְׂרָפוֹ֙ בְּמִפְקַ֣ד הַבַּ֔יִת מִח֖וּץ לַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’êṯ hap·pār ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ū·śə·rā·p̄ōw bə·mip̄·qaḏ hab·ba·yiṯ mi·ḥūṣ lam·miq·dāš
verses.literal: Then you are to take away - the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the appointed part of the temple area outside the sanctuary

verses.original: הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וּבַיּוֹם֙ תַּקְרִ֛יב תָּמִ֖ים שְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים לְחַטָּ֑את אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְחִטְּאוּ֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר חִטְּא֖וּ בַּפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šê·nî ū·ḇay·yō·wm taq·rîḇ tā·mîm śə·‘îr- ‘iz·zîm lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·ḥiṭ·ṭə·’ū ka·’ă·šer ḥiṭ·ṭə·’ū bap·pār
verses.literal: On the second day you are to present an unblemished male goat . . . as a sin offering - and the altar is to be cleansed as it was . . . with the bull

verses.original: בְּכַלּוֹתְךָ֖ מֵֽחַטֵּ֑א תַּקְרִיב֙ בֶּן־ בָּקָ֣ר תָּמִ֔ים פַּ֣ר תָּמִֽים׃ וְאַ֥יִל מִן־ הַצֹּ֖אן
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵal·lō·wṯ·ḵā mê·ḥaṭ·ṭê taq·rîḇ ben- bā·qār tā·mîm par tā·mîm wə·’a·yil min- haṣ·ṣōn
verses.literal: When you have finished the purification you are to present a young . . . unblemished bull and an unblemished ram from the flock

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְהִשְׁלִ֨יכוּ מֶ֔לַח עֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְהֶעֱל֥וּ אוֹתָ֛ם עֹלָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tām lip̄·nê Yah·weh hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hiš·lî·ḵū me·laḥ ‘ă·lê·hem wə·he·‘ĕ·lū ’ō·w·ṯām ‘ō·lāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must present them before the LORD the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them [as] a burnt offering to the LORD

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה שְׂעִיר־ לַיּ֑וֹם חַטָּ֖את יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ וּפַ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר וְאַ֥יִל מִן־ הַצֹּ֖אן תְּמִימִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm ta·‘ă·śeh śə·‘îr- lay·yō·wm ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ya·‘ă·śū ū·p̄ar ben- bā·qār wə·’a·yil min- haṣ·ṣōn tə·mî·mîm
verses.literal: For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering you are also to provide a young bull . . . . . . and a ram from the flock both unblemished

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יְכַפְּרוּ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְטִֽהֲר֖וּ אֹת֑וֹ וּמִלְא֖וּ יָדוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm yə·ḵap·pə·rū ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·ṭi·hă·rū ’ō·ṯōw ū·mil·’ū yå̄·ḏō
verses.literal: For seven days the priests are to make atonement - for the altar and cleanse it - so they shall consecrate it

verses.original: וִֽיכַלּ֖וּ אֶת־ הַיָּמִ֑יםס וְהָיָה֩ הַשְּׁמִינִ֜י בַיּ֨וֹם וָהָ֗לְאָה הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים יַעֲשׂ֨וּ עוֹלֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְאֶת־ שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֔ם עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ אֶת־ וְרָצִ֣אתִי אֶתְכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wî·ḵal·lū ’eṯ- hay·yå̄·mī·ms wə·hā·yāh haš·šə·mî·nî ḇay·yō·wm wā·hā·lə·’āh hak·kō·hă·nîm ya·‘ă·śū ‘ō·w·lō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·’eṯ- šal·mê·ḵem ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’eṯ- wə·rā·ṣi·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: At the end - of these days . . . from the eighth day on the priests are to present your burnt offerings - and peace offerings on the altar - Then I will accept you - declares the Lord GOD
